```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
```

```{r sturgeon_plot}
sturgeon_plot_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "merged_probes_methyl_calls_general.pdf")
if (file.exists(sturgeon_plot_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(sturgeon_plot_path, mustWork = TRUE), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Sturgeon classification plot not found.")
}
```

# MGMT Promoter Methylation
```{r MGMT}
mgmt_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "MGMT_analysis", "mgmt_prediction.tsv")
if (file.exists(mgmt_path)) {
  mgmt <- read_tsv(mgmt_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  kable(mgmt, caption = "MGMT Promoter Methylation Score")
} else {
  cat("MGMT methylation prediction not found.")
}
```

# Pseudotime Confidence Plot
```{r pseudotime_analysis}
pseudo_path <- file.path("results", params$sample, "pseudotime", "confidence_vs_pseudotime.png")
if (file.exists(pseudo_path)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(pseudo_path, mustWork = TRUE), rel_path = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Pseudotime confidence plot not found.")
}
```

```{r load-conf-stable, message=FALSE}
sample_id <- params$sample
confident_csv <- file.path("results", sample_id, "pseudotime", "confident_time.csv")
stable_csv    <- file.path("results", sample_id, "pseudotime", "stable_time.csv")

conf_time <- if (file.exists(confident_csv)) readr::read_csv(confident_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
stab_time <- if (file.exists(stable_csv))    readr::read_csv(stable_csv,    show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
```

```{r show-conf-stable}
dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(conf_time, metric = "First confident (≥0.8)"),
  dplyr::mutate(stab_time, metric = "Stable confident (4× ≥0.8)")
) |>
  dplyr::select(metric, time_min, covered_cpg, number_probes, label) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Sturgeon time-to-confidence estimates (minutes).")
```

```{r conf-stable-plot}
df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  dplyr::mutate(conf_time, metric = "First confident"),
  dplyr::mutate(stab_time, metric = "Stable (4×)")
)
if (!is.null(df) && nrow(df) > 0) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = metric, y = time_min)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = round(time_min, 1)), vjust = -0.5) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Minutes", title = "Time to confident classification")
}
```
